name: parentheses-after-a-tag-are-refused

name: a-number-in-parentheses-after-a-tag-is-refused
expect: "a number, a boolean, null or a path touches its tag by `#`: write `::Width#5`"

name: a-group-inside-a-literal-is-refused

name: a-name-inside-a-literal-is-refused

name: a-literal-under-a-tag-names-its-payload-built-by-get-and-the-tag-laid-after-it
query: :Box |~~ B ~~| (::kind | wires :w |~~ w ~~| /w ::number); get [~("::Box{:w (x)}" | parse !| message | endsWith "write `get {:w ~(x)} | tag ::Box`") ~(:x 3; get {:w ~(x)} | tag ::Box) ~("::number/add/SubjectNotNumberError!{:subject/found (1 | add 1)}" | parse !| message | contains "`get !{:subject/found ~(1 | add 1)} | tag ::number/add/SubjectNotNumberError | raise`") ~(get !{:subject/found ~(1 | add 1)} | tag ::number/add/SubjectNotNumberError | raise !| subject | found)]
